project_context.aesthetic: Cute and cozy, NYC bodega-style corner deli/kitchen
project_context.vibe: Warm, tactile, nostalgic but modern, appetizing
project_context.pages: Single-page marketing site + small Admin view for contact messages

typography.headings: Fraunces (Warm, vintage, soft serif). Use tracking-tight or tracking-tighter for large headlines.
typography.body: Outfit (Clean, modern, rounded geometric sans-serif). Use leading-relaxed.
typography.rules: NEVER use Inter, Roboto, or generic sans for headings. Use fluid text sizing (e.g., text-5xl sm:text-6xl) for the hero, never exceeding 6xl. Menu numbers (01, 02) should be in Fraunces, prominent and slightly offset.
typography.installation: Import Google Fonts for Fraunces and Outfit in index.css

colors.rules: Avoid pure #000000 and #FFFFFF. Maintain an 'Organic & Earthy' warm palette (Oat/Cream, Espresso text, Bodega Awning Red accent). Do not use flat defaults. Do NOT use dark colors as gradients.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use solid flat backgrounds with warm tinted borders (border-[#E8D8C8]). Soft, diffuse shadows (shadow-sm) rather than harsh drop shadows.
visual_enhancers.textures: Incorporate a subtle SVG noise/grain overlay on the page body to give it a tactile, 'paper/bodega' feel.
visual_enhancers.marquee: The 'Editorial Ribbon' pattern. Slow, smooth drift. Background #F5EBE1, text #D95333, text-sm, wide spacing (gap-24).

components.hero: Kinetic masked text reveal using Framer Motion (staggered line-by-line). Hero image should have a very subtle warm overlay (e.g., bg-[#2D2825]/30), ensuring the food/location is visible.
components.navigation: Sticky header with glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#FFFBF5]/80) and 1px bottom border.
components.menu_section: Numbered chapters (01. Breakfast, 02. Lunch). Search input should be pill-shaped, warm border, custom focus ring (focus:ring-[#D95333]). List items with clean right-aligned prices.
components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full). Primary buttons use brand_accent (#D95333) with text_primary (#FFFBF5). Apply a hover scale (scale-105) and active press effect.
components.admin_dashboard: High Density Grid (Bento style). Cardless or very slight border-radius (rounded-xl) with solid background for messages.
components.map: Embed Google Maps iframe with rounded-2xl corners, wrapped in a warm border.
components.contact_form: Floating label style or clean modern inputs. Minimalist. Save state locally to show in admin view.

layouts.general: Use generous spacing (p-8 to p-24). Mobile-first responsive grids. Break symmetry: offset menu categories slightly. Container must not be center-aligned globally.
layouts.admin: Responsive CSS Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3) with tight gaps (gap-6) for viewing messages.

motion.scrolling: MUST use 'lenis' (@studio-freight/react-lenis) for smooth momentum scrolling. Wraps the main layout.
motion.animations: Use Framer Motion. Elements should fade and slide up slightly on scroll. Staggered reveal for menu items.

accessibility.contrast: This project explicitly requested 'NOT ADA compliant'. This gives freedom to use subtle low-contrast text for decorative elements (like chapter subtitles), but keep core menu items and prices readable.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.

images.description: Red and white neighborhood diner exterior
Person holding a delicious deli sandwich
Coffee and avocado toast on a dark background

libraries.forms: react-hook-form (optional, or vanilla React state for simple implementation)

instructions_to_main_agent: Write components in .js or .jsx (not .tsx since this project uses JavaScript).
Do NOT use HTML-based components for advanced user interactions. Use custom tailored components or heavily styled ones matching the bodegas/deli theme.
Implement the 'Admin View' as a separate route or a conditional render (e.g. /admin) containing a simple grid of submitted contact forms.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors separate good from extraordinary.
Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN. Use the provided image URLs.
DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, or any surface that has content under it.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
